title: cyperus retroflexus var. pumilus
intro:
Cyperus retroflexus var. pumilus, commonly known as the dwarf umbrella sedge or dwarf umbrella plant, is a type of plant that belongs to the sedge family. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect the body from oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus retroflexus var. pumilus include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to relieve pain, reduce swelling, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
